subject: Consulting Activation Playlist: 6-Week Immersion & Ops Handoff
messages:
From: Eleanor Park <eleanor@trailstone.consulting>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Ruiz <j.ruiz@trailstone.consulting>
Date: 2028-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Partner activation — suggested 6-week immersion playlist

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Thanks again for yesterday's partner keynote — Trailstone is excited to move from intro -> execution. Attached is a compact "playlist" we put together: a 6-week immersion that blends solution briefings, hands-on labs, and an ops handoff for customer delivery teams.

High-level asks:
- Can Redwood provide a 90-minute technical lab slot in week 2 (GPU session + model variants)?
- Who from your side will own the final ops-runbook review in week 5?
- Any constraints on guest accounts / demo quotas we should be aware of?

I've attached the roster and checklist. Happy to iterate quickly — our goal is a repeatable activation that we can roll to three mutual customers in Q4.

Best,
Eleanor Park
Partner Lead, Trailstone Consulting

Attachments: Trailstone_Onboarding_Roster.xlsx (roster), 6-Week-Immersion-Checklist.pdf (playlist)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor@trailstone.consulting>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Jason Ruiz <j.ruiz@trailstone.consulting>
Date: 2028-10-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner activation — suggested 6-week immersion playlist

Eleanor — really appreciate the tidy format. This "playlist" approach makes it easy to operationalize. Quick answers inline: 

- Week 2 lab: yes, we can do a 90-minute technical session. Ben, can you confirm availability and lab plan?
- Ops runbook review: Laura will own the review and sign-off in week 5. We'll need the first draft at start of week 4 so we can iterate.
- Guest/demo quotas: we can provision 10 guest seats per partner for lab use; for real customer tests we'll move them to a shared sandbox with quotas. No billing during enablement.

Next steps:
1) Ben to confirm lab content + resource request by EOD 10/3.
2) Trailstone to share the first draft runbook by 10/20.
3) I'll set up the shared Drive folder and a recurring weekly 30m sync (Wednesdays 9am PT).

Thanks — looking forward.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference

---
On Sep 30, 2028, at 09:12, Eleanor Park wrote: (see above)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Eleanor Park <eleanor@trailstone.consulting>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Jason Ruiz <j.ruiz@trailstone.consulting>
Date: 2028-10-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner activation — suggested 6-week immersion playlist

Marissa / Eleanor — I'm good to lead the Week 2 deep dive. Draft outline below; happy to adjust based on Trailstone priorities.

Ben's Week 2 lab outline (90m):
- 0-10m: intro & goals (service levels, expected outcomes)
- 10-35m: architecture walkthrough (serving runtime, routing, dedicated vs hosted flows)
- 35-60m: hands-on lab: deploy a small model and run a demo with caching enabled (we'll provide a prebuilt image)
- 60-80m: troubleshooting & perf tuning (batching knobs, KV cache tips, light quantization tradeoffs)
- 80-90m: Q&A and next steps (lab artifacts published to Drive)

Resource requests:
- 2x small GPU instances reserved for lab time + one engineer for live troubleshooting
- Trailstone to supply a 3-person workshop roster (names/emails) so we can pre-provision guest seats

I'll attach a short ops SOP for the lab and a checklist for pre-provisioning. If that works I'll put the lab artifacts in the Drive folder Marissa creates.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Ops-Handoff-SOPs.docx (lab SOP and pre-provision checklist)

From: Jason Ruiz <j.ruiz@trailstone.consulting>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-12T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner activation — suggested 6-week immersion playlist

Marissa / Ben / Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming:
- Trailstone will finalize the runbook draft by 2028-10-20 and upload to your Drive folder.
- We accept the Week 2 lab outline; please reserve the two GPUs on 2028-10-18 09:00-10:30 PT.
- Roster attached (see Trailstone_Onboarding_Roster.xlsx).

One operational note: for the live demos we'd like a short escalation path (one Slack DM or on-call pager) in case of session-breaking infra issues. Can Redwood confirm an escalation contact?

Appreciate it — excited to get customers through this.

Best,
Jason Ruiz
Engagement Manager | Trailstone Consulting

Forwarded attachments: Trailstone_Onboarding_Roster.xlsx, 6-Week-Immersion-Checklist.pdf
